Why is EO different from ImageNet?.src: Why is EO different from ImageNet?

A foundation model trained on ImageNet h.zh: 在 ImageNet 上训练的基础模型见过 120 万张三通道 RGB 照片，这些照片由人类拍摄、也服务于人类。而卫星影像瓦片与上述任何一点都不相符：
A foundation model trained on ImageNet h.src:
A foundation model trained on ImageNet has seen 1.2M
          three-channel RGB photos shot by humans for humans. A
          satellite tile is none of those things:

@@T0@@Multi-spectral, not RGB.@@T1@@ Sen.zh: @@T0@@多光谱而非 RGB。@@T1@@ Sentinel-2 提供 13 个波段（可见光 + 近红外 + 短波红外 + 若干大气校正波段）。Landsat-8 有 11 个。高光谱传感器则达 200 个以上。ImageNet 骨干网络学会的是按固定顺序读取三个通道；一旦向其输入 13 个通道，补丁嵌入层甚至无法初始化。
@@T0@@Multi-spectral, not RGB.@@T1@@ Sen.src: Multi-spectral, not RGB. Sentinel-2 ships 13 bands (visible + near-IR + short-wave IR + a few atmospheric correction bands). Landsat-8 has 11. Hyperspectral sensors have 200+. ImageNet backbones have learned to read three channels in a fixed order; the moment you feed them 13, the patch-embed layer can't even initialise.

@@T0@@Calibrated radiance, not aesthetic.zh: @@T0@@标定辐亮度而非审美曝光。@@T1@@ 像素值是物理反射率，而非 sRGB。SWIR-1 波段中取值 0.27 的像素@@T2@@意味着@@T3@@某种定量的量。ImageNet 预训练中的自动曝光与色彩平衡假设在此只会起反作用。
@@T0@@Calibrated radiance, not aesthetic.src: Calibrated radiance, not aesthetic exposure. Pixel values are physical reflectances, not sRGB. A pixel of value 0.27 in the SWIR-1 band means something quantitative. Auto-exposure + colour-balance assumptions in ImageNet pretraining work against you.

@@T0@@Multi-temporal.@@T1@@ Most EO task.zh: @@T0@@多时相。@@T1@@ 大多数对地观测任务需要一系列的重访观测，以观察作物生长、城市变化与季节性。而 ImageNet 只看到单帧，仅此而已。
@@T0@@Multi-temporal.@@T1@@ Most EO task.src: Multi-temporal. Most EO tasks need a sequence of revisits to see crop growth, urban change, seasonality. ImageNet sees one frame, full stop.

@@T0@@Multi-resolution / multi-modal.@@T.zh: @@T0@@多分辨率 / 多模态。@@T1@@ 光学（10m）、雷达（SAR，5–20m）、高程（30m）、夜间灯光、气候。只了解其中一种模态的基础模型会遗漏 80% 的信号。
@@T0@@Multi-resolution / multi-modal.@@T.src: Multi-resolution / multi-modal. Optical (10m), radar (SAR, 5–20m), elevation (30m), nightlights, climate. A foundation model that knows only one of these misses 80% of the signal.

@@T0@@Heavy class imbalance + huge unlab.zh: @@T0@@严重的类别不平衡 + 庞大的无标注数据储备。@@T1@@ 陆地覆盖类别有 10–20 种，但地球上大部分区域属于其中三类之一（水体、森林、耕地）。标注代价高昂（往往依赖人工或专家），而无标注瓦片几乎是免费的。
@@T0@@Heavy class imbalance + huge unlab.src: Heavy class imbalance + huge unlabeled stash. 10–20 land-cover classes, but most of the planet is one of three (water, forest, cropland). Labels are expensive (often human/expert); unlabelled tiles are essentially free.

@@T0@@Hierarchical spatial scales.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@层级化的空间尺度。@@T1@@ 一块瓦片覆盖数平方公里。同一任务可能需要像素级输出（分割）、补丁级输出（该 64×64 图块中的窑炉）或瓦片级输出（1km² 范围内的森林砍伐率）。ImageNet 的分类头无法泛化到这些情形。
@@T0@@Hierarchical spatial scales.@@T1@@.src: Hierarchical spatial scales. A tile covers a few square km. The same task may need pixel-level (segmentation), patch-level (kiln in this 64×64 chip), or tile-level (deforestation rate over 1km²) outputs. ImageNet classification heads don't generalise.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n EO fo.zh:
@@T0@@一句话概括。@@T1@@
          对地观测基础模型以牺牲互联网影像的广度，换取遥感数据的深度与物理内涵。预训练目标并未改变（大多为 MAE）；改变的是数据、分词器与评估方式。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n EO fo.src: The slogan. EO foundation models trade the breadth of internet imagery for the depth and physics of remote sensing. The pretraining objective is unchanged (mostly MAE); the data, the tokenizer and the evaluation are completely different.

Two clusters: the MAE-on-multispectral c.zh: 可分为两大阵营：多光谱 MAE 阵营（Prithvi、SatMAE、Granite）与多模态阵营（Clay、MMEarth、AnySat）。前者结构更简单，在固定传感器上更强；后者在部署时更具灵活性，适用于尚不确定将获得何种波段或传感器的情形。
Two clusters: the MAE-on-multispectral c.src:
Two clusters: the MAE-on-multispectral camp (Prithvi, SatMAE,
          Granite) and the multi-modal camp (Clay, MMEarth, AnySat).
          The first is simpler and stronger on a fixed sensor; the
          second is more flexible at deployment time when you don't
          know what bands or sensors you'll get.

The pretraining objective: masked autoen.zh: 预训练目标：带若干变体的掩码自编码器
The pretraining objective: masked autoen.src: The pretraining objective: masked autoencoder, but with twists

Almost every successful EO FM uses a mas.zh: 几乎所有成功的对地观测基础模型都使用掩码自编码器（见@@T0@@视觉预训练一文@@T1@@的第 1 步）。这些变体至关重要：
Almost every successful EO FM uses a mas.src: Almost every successful EO FM uses a masked autoencoder (Step 1 of the vision-pretraining article). The twists matter:

@@T0@@Spectral masking.@@T1@@ Mask whole.zh: @@T0@@光谱掩码。@@T1@@ 掩蔽整个波段，而不仅是补丁。编码器必须学习波段与波段之间的关系（例如，NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) 隐含于任何光学基础模型之中）。SatMAE 与 MMEarth 即采用此做法。
@@T0@@Spectral masking.@@T1@@ Mask whole.src: Spectral masking. Mask whole bands, not just patches. The encoder must learn band-band relations (e.g. NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) is implicit in any optical FM). SatMAE and MMEarth do this.

@@T0@@Temporal masking.@@T1@@ Mask whole.zh: @@T0@@时相掩码。@@T1@@ 掩蔽多时相堆栈中的整个时间步。迫使模型对物候、天气与变化进行插值。代表工作为 Prithvi 2.0 与 Presto。
@@T0@@Temporal masking.@@T1@@ Mask whole.src: Temporal masking. Mask whole timesteps of a multi-temporal stack. Forces the model to interpolate phenology / weather / change. Prithvi 2.0 and Presto.

@@T0@@Modality drop.@@T1@@ With probabil.zh: @@T0@@模态丢弃。@@T1@@ 以概率 $p$ 丢弃整个模态（SAR / DEM / 气候）。这迫使模型具备优雅降级的能力。为 MMEarth 的标准方案。
@@T0@@Modality drop.@@T1@@ With probabil.src: Modality drop. With probability $p$, drop an entire modality (SAR / DEM / climate). Forces graceful degradation. MMEarth standard recipe.

@@T0@@Resolution + GSD encoding.@@T1@@ A.zh: @@T0@@分辨率与 GSD 编码。@@T1@@ 将地面采样距离（例如 10m 与 30m）作为词元嵌入加入，使模型能够对尺度进行归一化。Clay 与 AnySat 依赖于此。
@@T0@@Resolution + GSD encoding.@@T1@@ A.src: Resolution + GSD encoding. Add the ground-sample distance (e.g., 10m vs 30m) as a token embedding so the model can normalise scale. Clay and AnySat depend on this.

@@T0@@Climate / location conditioning.@@.zh: @@T0@@气候 / 位置条件化。@@T1@@ 许多近期模型以经纬度与季节为条件。这有助于泛化到未见区域。
@@T0@@Climate / location conditioning.@@.src: Climate / location conditioning. Many recent models condition on lat/lon and season. Useful for generalisation to unseen regions.

We synthesise a 6-band 64×64 tile (mimic.zh: 我们合成一块 6 波段 64×64 的瓦片（模拟 Sentinel-2 的 B2/B3/B4/B8/B11/B12），并赋予其跨波段的真实相关性（植被使绿光与近红外相关；水体抑制近红外；土壤在短波红外中凸显）。拖动掩码比例并选择要掩蔽的波段；重建结果是对可见补丁的智能填补，模拟 MAE 解码器所收敛到的结果。
We synthesise a 6-band 64×64 tile (mimic.src:
We synthesise a 6-band 64×64 tile (mimicking Sentinel-2's
          B2/B3/B4/B8/B11/B12) with realistic correlations across
          bands (vegetation correlates green and NIR; water suppresses
          NIR; soil pops in SWIR). Drag the mask ratio and which bands
          to mask; the reconstruction is a smart fill from the visible
          patches, mimicking what an MAE decoder converges to.

@@T0@@The single biggest mistake in EO M.zh:
@@T0@@对地观测机器学习论文中最严重的错误。@@T1@@
          即随机划分训练/测试集。相邻瓦片彼此相关；随机划分会把邻近瓦片同时放入训练集与测试集，使准确率高估 5–25%。空间分块（按 1°×1° 网格、国家、流域划分）才能反映真实的泛化能力。审稿时务必要求这一点。
@@T0@@The single biggest mistake in EO M.src: The single biggest mistake in EO ML papers. Random train/test split. Adjacent tiles are correlated; a random split puts neighbours in train and test, inflating accuracy by 5–25%. Spatial blocking (split by 1°×1° boxes, country, watershed) reveals real generalisation. Always require this in reviews.

Where general foundation models fit.zh: 通用基础模型的用武之地

DINOv2, SAM2, CLIP, and the new generati.zh: DINOv2、SAM2、CLIP 以及新一代视觉-语言模型同样可用于对地观测 — 有时效果极佳，有时则一塌糊涂。可参考的经验法则如下：
DINOv2, SAM2, CLIP, and the new generati.src:
DINOv2, SAM2, CLIP, and the new generation of vision-language
          models also work on EO — sometimes very well, sometimes
          terribly. Rules of thumb:

@@T0@@DINOv2 features on RGB tiles.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@DINOv2 特征用于 RGB 瓦片。@@T1@@ 在小样本对地观测分类上可持平或优于 ImageNet 预训练的 ResNet。但在多光谱或多时相数据上不如对地观测专用基础模型。
@@T0@@DINOv2 features on RGB tiles.@@T1@.src: DINOv2 features on RGB tiles. Match or beat ImageNet-pretrained ResNets on small-data EO classification. Worse than EO-specific FMs on multi-spectral or multi-temporal data.

@@T0@@SAM2 for segmentation prompts.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@SAM2 用于分割提示。@@T1@@ 若目标位于 RGB 影像中且视觉上易于区分（窑炉、船只、建筑、大片田地），则「在该目标周围勾出多边形」的零样本表现极佳。但在小目标或仅靠光谱可区分的类别上会彻底失效。
@@T0@@SAM2 for segmentation prompts.@@T1.src: SAM2 for segmentation prompts. Excellent zero-shot for "draw me a polygon around this object" if the object is in RGB and visually distinct (kilns, ships, buildings, large fields). Falls apart on small-object or spectral-distinguishable classes.

@@T0@@CLIP for retrieval.@@T1@@ Find til.zh: @@T0@@CLIP 用于检索。@@T1@@ 通过文本查询找到「包含砖窑」的瓦片 — 在 RGB 上效果出奇地好。可与对地观测专用嵌入结合以进行重排序。
@@T0@@CLIP for retrieval.@@T1@@ Find til.src: CLIP for retrieval. Find tiles "containing a brick kiln" via text query — works surprisingly well on RGB. Combine with EO-specific embedding for re-ranking.

@@T0@@Pixtral / GPT-4o for visual QA on.zh:
@@T0@@Pixtral / GPT-4o 用于瓦片上的视觉问答。@@T1@@
            当你希望快速探索时（「该瓦片中是否可见火情？」）颇为有用；但当需要定量的辐射测量答案时则毫无用处（此时@@T2@@热陷阱论证@@T3@@适用）。
@@T0@@Pixtral / GPT-4o for visual QA on.src: Pixtral / GPT-4o for visual QA on tiles. Useful when you want quick exploration ("are there fires visible in this tile?"), useless when you want quantitative radiometric answers (the thermal-trap argument applies).

@@T0@@VLM + EO FM stack.@@T1@@ The 2026.zh: @@T0@@VLM 与对地观测基础模型的组合。@@T1@@ 这是 2026 年的前沿方向：对地观测基础模型对瓦片进行嵌入；一个小型适配器将其投影到 LLM 空间；由 LLM 就瓦片回答自由形式的问题。EarthGPT / RemoteCLIP / GeoChat 是早期示例。
@@T0@@VLM + EO FM stack.@@T1@@ The 2026.src: VLM + EO FM stack. The 2026 frontier: EO FM embeds the tile; a small adapter projects to LLM space; the LLM answers free-form questions over the tile. EarthGPT / RemoteCLIP / GeoChat are early examples.

@@T0@@Don't pretrain unless you must.@@T.zh: @@T0@@除非必要，否则不要自行预训练。@@T1@@ 从 Prithvi 或 Clay 入手；你几乎不可能超越它们数万 GPU 小时的投入。只有在遇到上述模型未覆盖的领域偏移时才自行预训练（无人机、微卫星、含新波段的高光谱）。
@@T0@@Don't pretrain unless you must.@@T.src: Don't pretrain unless you must. Start with Prithvi or Clay; you almost certainly can't beat their tens-of-thousands of GPU-hours. Pretrain only for a domain shift not covered (UAV, micro-satellite, hyperspectral with novel bands).

@@T0@@The label budget is the model.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@标注预算才是关键。@@T1@@ 用冻结的基础模型加线性探测，在 200 个标注图块上的表现会比从零训练的 ResNet 高出约 15–30 个 mAP 点。
@@T0@@The label budget is the model.@@T1.src: The label budget is the model. 200 labelled chips with a frozen FM linear probe will beat 200 chips with a from-scratch ResNet by ~15-30 mAP points.

@@T0@@Tile size matters.@@T1@@ 224×224 i.zh: @@T0@@瓦片尺寸很重要。@@T1@@ 224×224 是 ViT 预训练基础模型的标准尺寸；许多对地观测目标（小型窑炉、建筑、车辆）需要更细的尺度；此时可采用 SAM 式高分辨率或滑动窗口方案。
@@T0@@Tile size matters.@@T1@@ 224×224 i.src: Tile size matters. 224×224 is the standard for ViT-pretrained FMs; many EO objects (small kilns, buildings, vehicles) need finer; reach for SAM-style high-res or sliding window.

@@T0@@Active learning + spatial blocking.zh:
@@T0@@主动学习 + 空间分块。@@T1@@
            将@@T2@@主动学习一文@@T3@@与空间分块交叉验证相结合，把标注预算花在真正能提升泛化能力的瓦片上。
@@T0@@Active learning + spatial blocking.src: Active learning + spatial blocking. Combine the active learning article with spatial-block CV to spend your label budget on tiles that genuinely improve generalisation.

@@T0@@Conformal prediction on outputs.@@.zh:
@@T0@@对输出施加保形预测。@@T1@@
            为任何已部署的对地观测模型套上@@T2@@保形预测@@T3@@以获得可信区间；其边缘覆盖率保证正是监管方所期望的。
@@T0@@Conformal prediction on outputs.@@.src: Conformal prediction on outputs. Wrap any deployed EO model in conformal prediction for trustworthy intervals; the marginal coverage guarantee is exactly what regulators want.

@@T0@@Calibration matters more here than.zh: @@T0@@此处校准比在 ImageNet 中更为重要。@@T1@@ 政策应用中「窑炉」的预测概率必须经过校准；可按区域使用温度缩放。
@@T0@@Calibration matters more here than.src: Calibration matters more here than in ImageNet. Predicted probability of "kiln" in policy applications must be calibrated; use temperature scaling per region.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n E.zh:
@@T0@@最终结论。@@T1@@
          对地观测基础模型之所以存在，是因为遥感是一种独特的模态。截至 2026 年，任何卫星机器学习项目的合理默认做法是：下载 Prithvi 或 Clay，冻结它，接上一个小型任务头，并在数据耗尽之前只训练该任务头。大部分工作量在于数据流水线与空间分块评估，而非模型本身。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n E.src: Final takeaway. EO foundation models exist because remote sensing is a modality apart. As of 2026 the right default for any satellite ML project is: download Prithvi or Clay, freeze it, add a small task head, and only train the head until you run out of data. Most of the work is in the data pipeline and the spatial-blocking evaluation, not the model.

meta.tagline: 卫星预训练骨干网络为何与众不同 — 模态、训练方案、下游评估与 2026 年的模型库
meta.summary: 对地观测基础模型深度导览：为何单块 Sentinel-2 瓦片就会打破 ImageNet 所建立的一切假设，哪些预训练目标真正实现了规模化（MAE / SatMAE / DINO / 像素-语言），2026 年的模型库（Prithvi、SatMAE++、Clay、AnySat、MMEarth、GFM、Presto），以及从原始 L1C 瓦片经预训练到真正超越 ImageNet 权重的微调的完整实例地图。包含一个在合成瓦片上运行的多波段掩码重建实时演示。
highlights: 为何 ImageNet 骨干网络会败给对地观测预训练的骨干网络（模态、尺度、标注稀缺）。
在合成 6 波段瓦片上实时运行多波段 MAE，并提供掩码比例与待掩蔽波段滑块。
2026 年模型库（Prithvi-100M / Prithvi-EO 600M、SatMAE / SatMAE++、Clay v1、AnySat、MMEarth、Presto、GFM、IBM/NASA Granite、SatlasPretrain）及其各自的预训练数据。
端到端完整流程：下载 Sentinel-2 → 切块 → 归一化 → 掩码 → 预训练 → 线性探测 → 为下游任务微调（窑炉检测、作物类型、生物量）。
与通用基础模型（DINOv2、SAM2、CLIP）的交叉引用，并说明通用基础模型在对地观测专用模型面前何时占优、何时落败。
